title: Two-Piece Zirconia Implants in the Posterior Area: Case Series With at Least 12 Months of Clinical and Radiographic Follow-Up. da
authors: Silva, A.M.P., Ferreira, D.d.C., Teixeira, M.K.S., Silva, A.M.d.O., Telles, D.M. and Lourenço, E.J.V. (2025), Oral Surg, 18: 514-522.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The two-piece zirconia implant system used in this report is a safe and reliable potential alternative in oral rehabilitation involving posterior teeth, with success observed over 12 months of follow-up” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
